arrival.text: THE ELDERWork's on the board. Men for hire wait at the posts, and the bar has drink.

ask.name: MS. ADAIR, FACILITIES
ask.said: Two tankers of water to our loading dock before sundown tomorrow. It pays 45 batteries, we do not negotiate upward, we are already generous.

client.name: MS. ADAIR, FACILITIES
client.text: Haul two tankers of waterMS. ADAIR, FACILITIES 45 batteries · 3 H
